findings.title: Variable comes from a pod label or annotation the pod does not have
findings.cause: container api exits because APP_VERSION is empty: it comes from the pod's label app.kubernetes.io/version (fieldRef metadata.labels['app.kubernetes.io/version']), and the pod has no such label, so the kubelet sets the variable to an empty string; the pod's labels are app, pod-template-hash; its log says: "APP_VERSION is empty: cannot tag the metrics"; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container api's log (current run)
evidence.detail: APP_VERSION is empty: cannot tag the metrics

evidence.what: APP_VERSION comes from metadata.labels['app.kubernetes.io/version']; the pod's labels are app, pod-template-hash
evidence.command: kubectl get pod api-8668bb5f87-9pkmp -n kd-downward-label-missing -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels}'

findings.fix: Add label app.kubernetes.io/version to the pod template's metadata (spec.template.metadata.labels of the workload), or point APP_VERSION at a label the pods have.
